assessment: The frozen Methodological Context is coherent with RQ-0012. It explicitly defines retraining/model update as use of new actual data to change base-model parameters, frames the decision among continued external correction, investigation/correction of non-model causes, and base-model retraining, rejects prediction-error increase alone as a retraining trigger, leaves numerical thresholds unfixed, and excludes retraining-algorithm and automated deployment design from the main scope. No Context defect was identified.
